name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2026-02-20, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.09 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
